in_marathi.name: Cheshta
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Wish, Desire, Intention
in_marathi.long_meaning: Cheshta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Cheshta is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chetana' meaning consciousness or awareness. The name Cheshta symbolizes the power of intention and the ability to manifest one's desires. It is also associated with the goddess Saraswati, the deity of knowledge and wisdom.
